entities.name: Louis Charles of Lorraine, Prince of Lambesc
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis of Lorraine was a member of the House of Guise, a cadet branch of the House of Lorraine. He married three times and through his daughter, is an ancestor of the present House of Savoy. He was the Grand Squire of France and Governor of Anjou.
